title: Neon Night
line: Night city glow: light type on deep indigo, a magenta accent, bokeh and a synthwave bed.
line_zh: 夜城光晕：深靛蓝上的亮色字，洋红点缀，散景光斑，合成器浪潮配乐。
prompt: Neon night style: light type on deep indigo, one hot magenta accent, soft glow pools and drifting bokeh, staggered letters and a slam, light-leak and zoom-through transitions, a synthwave bed with sci-fi whooshes and a stab on the reveal.
prompt_zh: 霓虹之夜风格：深靛蓝底上的亮色字，一抹热洋红，柔和光晕与漂移散景，逐字错落与重击字效，漏光与穿越缩放转场，合成器浪潮配乐，揭晓处配科幻呼啸与重音。
essence: A city after dark: deep ground, light that blooms around the words, and a bed that drives. The glow is atmosphere around the type, never on the type.

not.difference: Retro CRT is green phosphor in a mono face with scanlines; Neon Night is soft bloom and bokeh with a sans face.
Chrome Product is cool, metallic and restrained; Neon Night is saturated and warm-hot.

palette.logic: a deep indigo night, near-white ink, ONE hot magenta for the key word and the button

camera.expresses: the city breathing on a hold

sound.foley: sci-fi passes and a synth stab

signature_features.text: light ink on a deep indigo ground at 17:1, magenta at 6:1 (contrast.py)
light leaks, zoom-throughs, blur crosses and flashes between sections
a synthwave bed with sci-fi whooshes
staggered letters and a slam on the name
glow pools and bokeh sit behind the words, never on them
